The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 07b43c6077268638), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose U is a torsion-free product marking subgroup as above. Every finite subgroup F ⊂ G acts geometrically freely on Spec BU . There is an element aF ∈ BU with ∑ f∈F f(aF ) = 1. Multiplication by aF is continuous between bounded-denominator steps of finite coefficient bundles. It also acts continuously on bounded analytic section and compact-support models, with compact profinite parameters retained. Thus the geometric coefficient modules satisfy the trace and module-action hypotheses of Propositions 2.6 and 2.7. Equivalently they satisfy Definition 2.4.
